prompt: Create ONE striking original app icon: a classic push pin seen from the side, tilted about 40 degrees to the right as if just pushed in with flair. Wide flat cap on top, a waisted body that flares into a broad base collar, then a short tapered needle pointing down-left. A clean transparent gap separates the collar from the needle. Lively, elegant, a little playful, never cartoonish. Desktop app icon and window icon, unmistakable at 16 to 24 pixels, no detail smaller than one eighth of the icon width. Single flat graphite #555550 ink on genuine transparent background. Design fills 85% of the square canvas, centered. High-end desktop software icon design, as carefully drawn as a leading professional tool: thick precise geometric shapes, softened corners, confident proportions, generous negative space. No gradients, shading, shadows, outlines around the canvas, badge, tile, text, letters, mockup or 3D perspective.
